Class SqlStore

java.lang.Object
jvmumps.SqlStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
StoreApi
public final class SqlStore extends Object implements StoreApi
SQLite-backed StoreApi (WAL; tests use temp files).

Durable JavaM/mJVM store for integration (Sql*Smoke, itest). RSM remains the file-backed production M oracle (rsm.dat / global buffers) — not replaced by SQLite. Cross-process locks use mlocks; see also MStore for the ephemeral backend.
